results.market_title: Will there be no change in Fed interest rates after the October 2026 meeting?
results.reasoning: Prediction market aggregators (Kalshi/Polymarket, via DeFiRate as of early Oct 2026) show the Oct 28, 2026 FOMC meeting pricing a hold as the clear favorite (~84%), with a hike around 17-18% and a cut only ~2%. This is broadly consistent with the market's own crowd price of 79% for 'no change', suggesting the market is reasonably efficient and a hold is the modal outcome, though there is meaningful tail risk of a hike given some recent inflationary pressure narratives found in search results.
results.key_findings: ["DeFiRate (prediction market aggregator, data ~Oct 2-14 2026): Oct 28 FOMC meeting priced at 84% hold, 18% hike, ~2% cut","Some sources indicate the Fed had been on a hiking path through mid-2026 (e.g., a reported 25bp hike to 3.75-4% around Sept 2026), implying inflation concerns could still be live into October","Other sources described a cutting cycle through late 2025 with a hold since March 2026 at 3.50-3.75%, indicating some inconsistency/uncertainty in available data about the exact rate path","Resolution defaults to 'No change' bracket if no statement is issued by the next meeting, which is not expected to be an issue given the meeting is confirmed for Oct 27-28, 2026"]

results.market_title: Coca-Cola (KO) Q3 organic revenue (non-GAAP) growth 6.5% to 8%?
results.reasoning: Coca-Cola's own FY2026 guidance of ~5% organic revenue growth, following Q1 (+10%) and Q2 (+6%) results, implies the H2 2026 (Q3+Q4) revenue-weighted average must fall to roughly 2% to hit the full-year target, even before accounting for a flagged structural headwind of six fewer selling days in Q4. Q3 2026 faces a tough prior-year comp (Q3 2025 was already a strong +6%), and management's commentary points to a clear deceleration narrative rather than acceleration into the 6.5-8% band. While some of the H2 slowdown could be concentrated more in Q4 (due to the day-count headwind), allowing Q3 to land somewhat higher (plausibly 4-6%), reaching the 6.5-8% bracket would require Q3 to buck the deceleration trend Coca-Cola itself has guided toward.

results.market_title: Will Aleksandar Vučić – United Serbia win the most seats in the 2026 Serbian parliamentary election?
results.reasoning: Polling averages as of late October 2026 (PolitPro, Riotimes tracker) consistently show the Vučić-led SNS/'United Serbia' list leading the Student List by roughly 2-6 points (e.g., 46.7% vs 40.5%, 44.3% vs 42.5%), with aggregate trackers projecting the incumbent coalition retaining a 'stable majority'. executor.read: Venue: polymarket-us. Dry run while paperTradeMode is on: every paper entry/exit of the main lane is queued as an intent and consumed on the next 5-minute cron; each is routed to the Polymarket US moneyline (league -> game -> long/short side) and priced on that book with its 0.0695 x p(1-p) fee; clobRef is the same intent on the global CLOB for comparison. Nothing is placed while dry. order = the FOK limit the executor would send (YES-price convention, tick-rounded, contracts). execPriceC = volume-weighted effective price for the paper size; slippageC = cents worse than the paper price; wouldReject = live rules that would refuse it (min size, slippage cap 5c, thin book); wouldBlock = the daily risk gates. routing.unroutable = intents with no Polymarket US market (the live path skips those trades). roundTrips diff buy+sell (both fees) against the paper ledger; dryMinusPaper is how much paper overstates. Maker mode (orderMode): a BUY rests post-only at the best level on our side (good-till-date = the TTL) instead of crossing; dry fills it when the market trades through the level or a print lands there, and at the TTL takes the taker fill (fallback) or skips; takerRef on a maker fill is the FOK it would have sent at placement, so maker.savedVsTakerUsd and roundTrips.makerMinusTakerOnFilled are the maker edge on the trades that filled; maker.missed are entries that never filled. Exits stay taker. Live: only with paperTradeMode off and PMUS_KEY_ID/PMUS_SECRET_KEY set; consumes the live exec queue, FOK limit or close-position with synchronous execution, confirms fills to the auto-trader, reconciles ambiguous sends against the account position and halts itself if that fails. POST /autotrader/executor/halt is the kill switch.

xvenue.read: polyMoves = minutes where Polymarket's mid moved >= 3c; staleKalshi = of those, Kalshi's same-minute quote was still crossable after its 7.000000000000001% x p(1-p) taker fee (avgStaleEdgeC = cents of edge per share); kalshiSameMin/NextMin = Kalshi moved the same way that minute / the next; kalshiLeads = Kalshi moved first and Polymarket followed. A Kalshi lane is worth building only if staleRate x avgStaleEdgeC is meaningfully positive over many games. us* = the same for Polymarket US (taker 6.950000000000001% x p(1-p)); kUsCross = minutes where buying on one US-legal venue and selling on the other cleared both taker fees (the only fully legal arbitrage pair for a US operator).

usLane.read: Paper only: each event is a hypothetical taker fill on Polymarket US at the sampled quote (px, qty = shares shown at that price; one event per game minute, on the leg the US instrument quotes). tradable = the subset with at least 50 shares shown (usd = dollars on the shown size, capped at 1000 shares) in a minute where global Polymarket's mid moved >= 3c and the US quote was still crossable after the 6.950000000000001% x p(1-p) taker fee (edgeC = cents of edge at entry). marks.* = cents per share after the entry fee, marked at global Polymarket's mid 1/5/15/60 minutes later and at the end of the game (final), and at settlement (0/1); exit fees and the US spread are not charged on those. marks.x5 / marks.x15 are the round trip: closed on the Polymarket US book 5 / 15 minutes later (the bid for a buy, the ask for a sell, so the spread is paid) with the exit taker fee charged too - what a scalping lane would actually have booked. roiPct = avg mark pnl / avg entry price. noData = horizon passed with no sample. Decision rule (docs/PROFIT-AVENUES.md Part 2): after ~200 events, a Polymarket US lane is worth building only if the round trip (x5 or x15) is positive on the tradable subset with a hit rate above 50%, or settle is; the real-money flip stays the operator's call.
